(Japanese: '''VSフーディン''' ''VS {{tt|Foodin|Alakazam}}'') is the 70th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Adv|Green}}, {{Adv|Bill}}, and {{Adv|Yellow}} meet {{Adv|Blue}}, {{adv|Blaine}}, [[Lt. Surge]], [[Koga]], and [[Sabrina]] inside [[Cerise Island]]. When Yellow, Green, Bill, Blue, and Blaine, wonder why [[Team Rocket]] is there, they respond by saying to defeat the [[Elite Four]]. Blue confesses that he only came to defeat [[Agatha]]. Sabrina's {{p|Alakazam}} then hands out [[Spoons of Destiny]] to pick battle partners. The battle plan is to face each of the Elite Four in groups of two. The first pair is Yellow and Blaine, the second is Koga and Blue, the third pair is Sabrina and Green, and the fourth pair, both with unmoving Spoons of Destiny, is Lt. Surge and Bill. Afterwards, the groups split up. Blue then gives Koga back his {{TP|Koga|Golbat}}. ==Major events== * [[Sabrina]] uses the [[Spoons of Destiny]] so the group can fight the [[Elite Four]] in different groups. * {{Adv|Blue}} returns [[Koga's Golbat]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Blue}} * {{Adv|Green}} * {{Adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Brock]] * [[Lt.
